description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with Effect from 09.09.2024 to 15.09.2024
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). The notification includes the exercise of statutory powers, sets compliance requirements for customs payments, and formally rescinds previous regulations, all characteristic of legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
